rationale: The assistant correctly identified moisture from cleaning as the cause. It advised isolating power, drying, refitting the caps, and calling a Gas Safe engineer only if the clicking persists. It included a gas smell safety check and recommended no part. Weaknesses: it asked no questions and stated 'almost certainly got into the ignition switches' before confirming that water got in. It also assumed spray cleaner was used when the customer only said they cleaned the hob. The 24-48 hour drying period is somewhat excessive, and it suggested removing the knobs, which is mostly harmless.
